description: A sixteen-step counter pushed one way by one input and the other way by the other, with sixteen gate outputs that go high on fixed steps of the count

inputs.text: Moves the count on one step every time the voltage here crosses 1V, going up and coming back down alike
Moves the count back one step every time the voltage here crosses 1V, going up and coming back down alike

notes: both inputs drive one shared count, so two clocks at different rates pull it back and forth and the sixteen outputs beat against each other; with one clock patched the count runs one way only.
each input counts on both edges, so a square wave moves the count twice per cycle.
with nothing patched the count stands at step 1 and the three outputs belonging to that step stay at 5V.
